title: Policy Scenarios & Climate Modelling
goal: Model environmental policy scenarios using si + imperfect subjunctive (-ra/-se) with passive se and conditional outcomes.

items: I can model policy scenarios with *si se* + imperfect subjunctive (*-ra* or *-se*) and the conditional.
I can maintain plural agreement in passive *se* clauses inside hypothetical policy proposals.
I can use key terms for carbon taxes, fossil fuels, mitigation, climate adaptation and emissions quotas.
